title: Schedule of Presidential Candidates for Next Monday
subtitle: Presidential hopefuls plan diverse activities this weekend
excerpt: The presidential candidates’ schedule features rallies, political actions, walks, leafleting, municipal visits, event participation, and demonstrations.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The presidential candidates’ schedule for this weekend includes rallies, political actions, walks, and leafleting. The programs are spread across various cities and regions of the country, focusing on mobilizing the support base and presenting proposals to voters.

In addition to field activities, the candidates have also scheduled municipal visits and participation in events and cultural demonstrations. These meetings aim to strengthen ties with the local community, demonstrate presence, and listen to citizens’ demands.

The candidates also plan meetings with business leaders and supporters, seeking to reinforce alliances and secure logistical and financial backing for their campaigns. The program reflects the diversity of strategies adopted by the candidates to win votes before the presidential election.

With information from Agência Brasil.
